basic_details.job_title: TIDCL Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

age_limit.details: Upper age limit: Up to 40 years as on 30/10/2026.

qualification.details: Candidates must be Indian Citizens. | Essential: Minimum 2 to 3 years of relevant post qualification experience in a reputed organization. | Desirable: Experience in project management, team handling, MIS reporting, regulatory compliance, or any domain-specific tasks. | Good knowledge of MS office tools and relevant software/applications. salary_details.assistant manager: Rs.40,000/- (Rupees Forty thousand) only per month (consolidated)

how_to_apply: Visit the official website at tidc.tripura.gov.in or tripura.gov.in to download the prescribed application format.
Fill out the application form with all required details.
Affix a recent passport size photograph on the application form.
Attach photocopies of all relevant documents, certificates, and testimonials.

Submit the complete application via email to [email protected] on or before 30 October 2026 up to 5:30 PM. Alternatively, send complete applications giving details of Name, Date of Birth (Age), Address with contract No., experience, and recent passport size photograph supported with attested copies of testimonials to the office address: Tripura Industrial Development Corporation Ltd. (TIDC Ltd.), Shilpa Nigam Bhavan, Khejurbagan, Kunjaban, Agartala, Tripura, Pin-799006.
important_instructions: The positions are purely on a contractual basis for a period of 11 (eleven) months with consolidated remuneration at Tripura Industrial Development Corporation Ltd. (TIDC Ltd.), Shilpa Nigam, Bhavan, Khejurbagan, Agartala, West Tripura. The positions can be extended on mutual consent, and the candidate engaged will have to execute an agreement with TIDC Ltd. which will be renewable based on satisfactory performance. The candidate engaged to this position shall not be part of the regular staff in the matter of recruitment to regular post. The candidate engaged shall have no vested right prior to and after the completion of the contract period to ask for regularization / absorption in TIDC Ltd. During the contract, if required, the contractual staff will have to proceed to any part of India and will perform such duties as may be assigned to him / her in connection with the work of TIDC Ltd. Candidates should come for the interview with a copy of bio data, original certificates and testimonials. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The selected candidates may be required to join immediately.

content_sections.text: The positions are purely on a contractual basis for a period of 11 (eleven) months with consolidated remuneration at Tripura Industrial Development Corporation Ltd. (TIDC Ltd.), Shilpa Nigam, Bhavan, Khejurbagan, Agartala, West Tripura. The positions can be extended on mutual consent, and the candidate engaged will have to execute an agreement with TIDC Ltd. which will be renewable based on satisfactory performance. The candidate engaged to this position shall not be part of the regular staff in the matter of recruitment to regular post. The candidate engaged shall have no vested right prior to and after the completion of the contract period to ask for regularization / absorption in TIDC Ltd. During the contract, if required, the contractual staff will have to proceed to any part of India and will perform such duties as may be assigned to him / her in connection with the work of TIDC Ltd. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: Tripura Industrial Development Corporation Limited (TIDCL Ltd.) is conducting the recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under TIDCL Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies are available for the Assistant Manager post (ST-1 and SC-1).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for TIDCL Assistant Manager posts?
faq.answer: The last date of application submission is 30 October 2026 up to 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for TIDCL Assistant Manager?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess M.Com/MBA with knowledge in computer application along with 2 to 3 years of relevant post qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 40 years as on 30/10/2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly consolidated salary for the Assistant Manager post?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated remuneration is Rs. 40,000/- (Rupees Forty thousand) only.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates may submit their applications through email to [email protected] or by post/hand to the office of TIDCL Ltd., Shilpa Nigam Bhavan, Khejurbagan, Kunjaban, Agartala, Tripura, Pin-799006.

faq.question: Q9. Is the recruitment permanent?
faq.answer: No, the positions are purely on a contractual basis for a period of 11 (eleven) months and do not confer any right to regularisation or absorption in TIDCL Ltd.
